label: Revision tree (Sync Gateway, pre-4.0 revision tracking)
type: Sync Gateway's original tree-based revision-tracking scheme, retained in parallel with sgw:version-vector in 4.0+ deployments for backward compatibility with Couchbase Lite clients earlier than 4.0.
note: SIGNIFICANCE EXCEPTION alongside sgw:version-vector: promoted at recurrence 1 because sgw:version-vector's own record cannot state what it replaced, or why parallel trees are maintained, without naming this sibling - the same family-cannot-be-defined-without-its-sibling test round 26 applied to server:full-recovery/server:delta-recovery.
